title: Runtime smoke tests: character creation + level-up to 20
description:
Re-freeze bar #10. Runtime smoke tests exercising the generated pack as a playable model, using ONLY generated pack data — no consumer-side hardcoded SRD knowledge and no overlays.

SCOPE (deterministic, NOT combinatorial): 
  - Every legal class/ancestry/background TUPLE (~12 classes x 13 ancestries x backgrounds) created at level 1 with DETERMINISTIC representative choices (fixed seed/first-legal-option), asserting derived stats.
  - Then level REPRESENTATIVE characters through 20, exercising subclass selection where required.
Do NOT enumerate every legal spell/equipment/choice combination.

Plus TARGETED choice-coverage cases: Half-Elf ASI/skill choices; Wizard spellbook + preparation; Cleric/Druid prepared-caster formula; Bard known-spells; Fighter and Cleric starting-equipment choices; a subclass-dependent level-up; an ASI-vs-feat row; and a feature-improvement row. This is the executable proof of the playable bar.
